test_title: PYST 55: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven friends - M, N, O, P, Q, R, and S - are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). O is sitting third to the right of S. N is sitting second to the right of O. Q is an immediate neighbour of both M and S. P is an immediate neighbour of both O and N.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of R?
